title: Expression data from meningiomas and normal meninges

publications.title: Gene expression profiles of meningiomas are associated with tumor cytogenetics and patient outcome.

institution: Cancer Research Center (IBMCC), University of Salamanca / Servicio General de Citometria

normal_control_tissue.type: purified RNA from normal meningeal cells, commercially sourced (BioChain Institute, Hayward CA and US Biological, Swampscott MA), each deposited as its own GSM record

processed_data_format: GSM-level MAS5/normalized values (sample data table); no combined series-level processed matrix file
needs_manual_review_reason: Live GEO verification (2026-07-11) confirms 51 total deposited GSM samples: 47 meningioma tumors plus 4 normal-meninges controls (matching the discovery-log claim of '47 tumor + 4 normal'), each with its own individually deposited GSM record (unlike some other records in this batch where controls are only supplementary-file reference data). Independently corroborated via two discovery paths per the task brief: a Synapse-hosted curated meta-collection cross-reference, and a Srivastava-lab author search that surfaced this record via its citation in PMID 28938569 (Gupta et al., Oncotarget 2017, 'Evaluation of autoantibody signatures in meningioma patients using human proteome arrays') -- note that PMID 28938569 is NOT itself a publication generated from this dataset (it is an unrelated proteomic autoantibody study that cites this series only as background/comparison), so it was not added to the publications array; the true linked publication is PMID 18637901 (Tabernero et al., Brain Pathology 2009), confirmed via GEO's own Series_pubmed_id field and matching the series design (cytogenetic-subgroup correlation) exactly. Per rule against overclaiming outcome status: despite that paper's title mentioning 'patient outcome', three spot-checked GSM records (GSM1060065, GSM1060066, GSM1060100, plus control GSM1060112) show only gender/age/cytogenetic-group/who-grade/histology fields, no survival or recurrence field of any kind, so has_outcome_data is correctly left false; the 'patient outcome' association claimed in the paper's title appears to be a downstream survival analysis in the manuscript, not a field deposited in GEO. cytogenetic group (e.g. Diploid, Complex karyotype, presumably also isolated -22/22q- and del(1p36) per the design text) is a genuine named molecular subtype system, so molecular_subtype_annotated is set true; a full per-sample grade tally across all 47 tumors has since been performed (see 2026-07-12 update below). large_cohort left false pending centralized quartile recomputation. FACT-CHECK UPDATE (2026-07-12): full per-sample census of all 51 GSM records (family.soft) performed. grade_breakdown populated from the per-sample 'who grade' field over the 47 tumors (grade I=33, II=12, III=2; the 4 normal-meninge controls carry 'who grade: Not applicable' and are excluded); tags.grade_comparable set true. sex_distribution populated (34 female, 13 male across the 47 tumors) and age_distribution populated (range 23-84 years) from per-sample 'gender'/'age' fields. molecular_subtype_annotated remains true (per-sample 'cytogenetic group': Diploid, Complex karyotype, del22q/Monosomy 22, del 1p/Loss 1p, etc.). has_outcome_data remains false (no survival/recurrence field in any GSM).
